- **`/track`** — Customers enter tracking # to see status + progress bar + estimated delivery
- **`/dispatch`** — Dispatchers (role-based) create shipments, update statuses
- **API** (`/api/shipments/*`) — Minimal API endpoints with role authorization
- **Roles** — `Dispatcher` and `Customer` seeded at startup
- **Database** — SQLite with EF Core migrations (Shipments table with tracking number, status, customer/dispatcher FK)
